text:
morgan: seeing a sudden control-plane hiccup in eu-west around 09:12 UTC — apiserver request backlog jumped and a bunch of leader leases dropped after a GPU provisioning spike. kubectl shows controller-manager restarts.
irene: any alerts? which clusters affected?
morgan: alerted via SLOs — clusters: gpu-pool-eu-west-1 and controlplane-eu-west-1-api. apiserver 500s -> request_backlog metric spiked to ~4200.
sam: @morgan can you paste the apiserver logs around the spike?
morgan: here's the immediate excerpt:
```
I0318 09:12:05.123456 1 trace.go:205] Trace[123]: "List etcd3" ... took 5123.24ms
E0318 09:12:05.123890 1 authentication.go:253] failed to authenticate request: etcdserver: request timed out
W0318 09:12:07.223001 1 lease.go:410] could not renew lease controller-manager-lease: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
```
vik: looks like etcdLeaderRenew failures — maybe disk IO or network saturated during GPU boot storms.
alan: I/O watch: iostat shows iowait spikes on etcd nodes coincident with nvme throughput from gpu-pool provisioning.
morgan: timeline: a burst of ~120 GPU nodes came up at 09:11 for a scheduled batch job; they pulled images and pushed heavy egress + registry traffic. that coincides with controlplane latency.
irene: ops-bot — did anything hit egress quotas or peering throttles?
ops-bot: @channel egress_peering_rate limited on eu-peer-1 between 09:10:30 and 09:13:00 (rate=850Mbps -> throttled at 800Mbps). No packet loss detected, increased retransmits.
sam: ok can we mitigate quickly? suggestions: 1) temporarily scale etcd to 5 -> 7 replicas? 2) increase apiserver request-timeout? 3) cordon new GPU nodes to stop image pulls?
vik: cordoning helped last time. image pulls are the noisy neighbor here. recommend `kubectl cordon` the recently provisioned nodes and GC pre-pulled images via DaemonSet on a subset.
alan: started a quick rolling restart of controller-manager to re-establish leases — doing in a staggered way to avoid mass leader churn.
morgan: doing cordon now on nodes with label provisioning=burst-2026-03-18:
```
kubectl get nodes -l provisioning=burst-2026-03-18 -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl cordon
```
sam: can we offload registry pulls to a cached mirror in the same AZ? that's longer term but reduces egress spikes.
irene: rolling restart completed for controller-manager (2/3) — watching leader elections.
ops-bot: leader_election events: controller-manager restored leader after second restart at 09:14:21.
morgan: apiserver request backlog down from 4200 -> 130 in 2m after cordon + restart. etcd latencies still a bit elevated (~120ms p95) but trending down.
vik: followup action items: 1) create node-provisioning QoS so image pulls use local mirror, 2) add egress rate smoothing for scheduled bursts, 3) add alert for image-pull egress correlated with control-plane latency.
alan: filing a cost review for mirror bandwidth vs current peering overages — ccing finance later.
sam: oncall, please keep an eye for recurrence this afternoon during the next batch run.
morgan: thanks all — marking as mitigated for now. will open an incident ticket with timeline + logs.
deploy-bot: incident-ticket #INC-2026-118 created by morgan: "cp-lease-renewal-glitch during gpu provisioning burst (eu-west)". link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-118 :white_check_mark:
morgan: will follow up with RCA doc and config PRs for mirror + cordon automation. :eyes:
